messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#1024] Is R Hadoop compatible with Map Reduce 2 aka YARN?
parts:
Hi,
we did some testing on apache hadoop 2.1.0 with rmr2 and it passed all the tests. I assume that mr2 is the default in 2.1.0 but I am not totally sure. For the other packages, plyrmr depends on Hadoop only through rmr2 so the answer is going to be the same, rhdfs and rhbase should be independent of mr1 or mr2 but we haven't tested them on 2.1.0 yet. We are committed to make RHadoop work on mr2, so solving any compatibility issue will take a high priority for us.


Antonio
